name: How much does a kitchen lighting upgrade cost in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen lighting upgrade cost in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen lighting upgrade in the Las Vegas area varies significantly based on the project's scope, fixture types, and electrical work required. Basic upgrades involving swapping out existing fixtures might cost a few hundred dollars. More extensive projects, such as installing new recessed lighting, under-cabinet lighting, or moving electrical lines, can range from a few thousand to over ten thousand dollars. Factors like smart home integration or high-end designer fixtures also impact the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely from a few hundred to over ten thousand dollars, depending on the project scope, fixture choices, and electrical work needed. We provide detailed estimates.
